AbsenceFinding.description:
An absence answer is a claim about a SEARCH, not about the patient.
Cannot be constructed without its search scope.
AbsenceFinding.title: AbsenceFinding

AggregateCell.description: PHI-minimised: no content, no patient or encounter identifiers; small cells '<5'.
AggregateCell.title: AggregateCell

BubbleStatus.description: The ONLY answers a question bubble may give (Section 8.8).
BubbleStatus.title: BubbleStatus

ChangeView.description: Diff chip data: '+ new', '~ explicit change', '= carried forward', '! contradicts'.
ChangeView.title: ChangeView

Decision.description: Append-only record of a human decision.
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionRequest.description: What a client sends. Rationale text is held in memory only, never logged.
DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest

Evidence.description:
Version-bound anchor. Wire name of source_version_id is note_version_id.

Span evidence cites a SourceVersion. ``encounter_record`` evidence (OWN-001 only) cites a
structured encounter field instead: no source version, no span, no quote. It is never a
fake anchor on some note.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceRef.description:
Points at one cited span, e.g. the allergy entry a clinician confirms as correct.
Clients hold evidence, never assertion ids; the engine maps a ref to its assertion(s).
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

Flag.description: Serialises to the appendix flag JSON exactly, plus additive fields.
Flag.title: Flag

FlagCategory.description: Wire ``category`` values (kebab-case, as in the appendix example).
FlagCategory.title: FlagCategory

GlanceView.description: Top strip (Section 13): computed server-side; the UI only renders it.
GlanceView.title: GlanceView

LoginRequest.description: Synthetic login for the demonstrator: pick a synthetic staff member.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

PreparedCheck.description: What a non-clinician attaches when marking a flag ready for clinician (L16).
PreparedCheck.title: PreparedCheck

ReasonCode.description: Fixed reason codes (L15). Which codes each action allows is in permissions.py.
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

RecordField.description: Structured encounter fields an ``encounter_record`` evidence item may name.
RecordField.title: RecordField

Role.description:
System (authorisation) role of a staff member. Distinct from Discipline,
which describes a source document, and from TeamRole.
Role.title: Role

RuleId.title: RuleId

SourceView.description: Metadata only (no text). Text is fetched per version via SOURCE_TEXT.
SourceView.title: SourceView

StaleRevision.description: 409 body extension: current state and the other actor's decision (feedback 10).
StaleRevision.title: StaleRevision

human_review_statement.const: Requires human review. Not the medical record. Does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
human_review_statement.default: Requires human review. Not the medical record. Does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
human_review_statement.title: Human Review Statement

SummaryClaim.description:
Every claim is a deterministic template over flag/decision/bubble records,
with evidence. No free paraphrase.
SummaryClaim.title: SummaryClaim

WorkspaceInfo.description: The workspace token lives only in JS memory (Section 6.3).
WorkspaceInfo.title: WorkspaceInfo

get.description:
Needs the session cookie but not the workspace header (opened in a new tab); the token
is bound to the issuing staff member and workspace and re-checked against the care team.

schema.title: Response List Encounters Api Encounters Get
Response List Flags Api Encounters  Encounter Id  Flags Get

409.description: stale_revision: StaleRevision body (current state and the other actor's decision). invalid_transition: {error_code} only; branch on error_code.
